steps.note: Thermisation; the Guelph home recipe holds 52 °C for about 1.5 h.
Nozzle centrifuge (feed about 27 °C) or ultrafiltration today, cloth bags traditionally; the soured curd is spun apart into curd and acid whey, with a pH of about 4.3-5.

quark.text: Skimmed milk is soured by mesophilic lactococci with a trace of rennet until it gels at about pH 4.6; the gel is stirred, warmed briefly and the curd is separated from the whey in a centrifuge. Fat is set by adding cream.
